meta.edited: 回應是 2026-10-15 匿名 WEB browse 的真實回應（Flutter 官方頻道的公開歌單），刪減到只剩插件讀的路徑：lockupViewModel 的 contentId、contentType、縮圖（前兩個尺寸）、時長角標、標題、頻道名與觀看次數，標頭的標題、擁有者與筆數，playlistMetadataRenderer 的標題與描述，以及項目區塊最後的 continuationItemViewModel（原樣，含 clickTrackingParams）；sectionListRenderer 後面另一個 continuationItemViewModel 刪了。請求的 body 與標頭、回應的標頭沿用 mix 錄製（fixtures/mix/003.json，2026-10-14）。續取 token 換成 ***（FMP 的遮蔽名單認 token 欄位）；Node 測試把它換成假值。

playlistMetadataRenderer.title: Flutter Widget of the Week
playlistMetadataRenderer.description:
Fighting the good fight for Widget Awareness! Widget of the Week is a series of quick, animated videos, each of which covers a particular widget from the Flutter SDK. Need to know why you'd choose to use a SafeArea widget, or how to position a child within a Stack, but don't have much time? Then, this series is for you!

Subscribe to Flutter → http://goo.gle/FlutterYT
